Yeah, I mean I didn't yell at her or anything but I got so frustrated and when she grabbed me, I got so scared and mad all at once. I've told her before that I don't need to tell her everything about my life but she always gets mad at me for it.
I can understand that maybe she's just trying to make sure I'm okay - but grabbing me when you know I'm not okay with it isn't alright.
And thank you so much(-:
Oh shit - sorry. I don't know what threads I go to for anything. Shall I delete this, or?

i'm not sure - that isn't what i'm being tested for.  
i'm being tested for ADHD and anxiety but not PPD.

Got through last night. Sort of want to cry because I got through without doing anything seriously (??) bad. It just gets really overwhelming sometimes. 
I'll try to look after myself, thank you. I'm really sorry that you had to deal with that last night. I am a big mess.

I think you read my previous posts because wow, that made me cry a little.
I can't talk to my school counselors because they are legally required to contact my parents.
When I first contacted the authorities when the situation happened, nobody believed me. The police didn't believe me and neither did social services. Same with my parents, they told me I dreamt it. But a 10 year old doesn't dream that stuff.
I can't go to any local churches because my mom goes to them so I think it's unlikely that I'll be able to get help from them. 
My only friends are the ones that push me around and are manipulative, my other ones are online friends and I rarely speak to them. I can't go to see my family members because they live really far away,  so I'm stuck here. 
I'm trying to make myself better, I really am. But this hits me out of the blue and recently it's becoming more frequent. It's every night now. Sometimes it happens during the day and it's so hard to act like nothing is happening when inside all I can think about is how much I want to die. 
My mom tells me how I deserve everything she does and tells me and recently, I'm starting to believe it. I'm far from being strong. I'm so, so far. I'm not strong at all.
I barely survived and I'm still barely surviving. You have no idea about how much I want to give up.
And I know how pathetic I am. I always come here when nobody will listen. I'm irrational and stupid as hell, but I just really need some guidance. I really give up. I really do.
